_doc: The L4 Dependency Graph + Reality Leverage objective. milestones = the ordered critical path to the FIRST real-world L4 event (a real customer money action through the gate). The question is no longer 'what unlocks the workflow engine?' but 'what unlocks the first L4?'. opportunity_l4 = the honest expected NEW L4 evidence each existing opportunity would create (default 0 — most of the roadmap builds capability and creates ZERO L4). Reality Leverage = expected_new_L4 / effort re-ranks everything: the minimal path to reality beats the biggest internal build.

milestones.label: A real human logs in against the live verifier
milestones.description: A real person (not a test bearer) authenticates a real session against the booted server's real verifier. The dev-auth signer + live route tests already exist; what is missing is a human-present run with a seeded company.
milestones.blocked_by: HUMAN login (artifacts ready: tools/first-l4/ — dev-auth fast path needs NO prod IdP; agent prep complete)
milestones.would_create_event: L4: real user authenticated a live session against the real verifier (user_real=1)

milestones.label: Real user loads a company with zero cross-tenant leak
milestones.description: That real user opens a real company in a live multi-company session; ScopePath tenancy shows zero cross-tenant data. Smoke-proven at the API (L3); this proves it at the real-user/UI layer.
milestones.would_create_event: L4: live-authed multi-company session, zero cross-tenant leak (user_real=1, data_real=1)

milestones.label: Real ERP/finance state renders through the full stack
milestones.description: The user sees real (seeded-but-real-shaped) ERP/finance data rendered end-to-end through the live feed. A real read; supports the money path but is not itself a money L4.
milestones.would_create_event: real ERP data rendered through the live stack (supporting evidence)

milestones.label: A real money action (even $1) is proposed through the live gate
milestones.description: A minimal real money action — a $1 invoice — is proposed through the live money gate with real data. Does not need the whole billing suite, just the minimal real-money slice.
milestones.would_create_event: real money action proposed through the live gate (pre-commit)

milestones.label: A real board principal approves it (SoD, live)
milestones.description: A real board principal (non-requester) approves the money action over a live session — separation-of-duties exercised by real people, not a test.
milestones.would_create_event: real SoD board approval over a live session

milestones.label: It executes and writes a real audit row — THE first money L4
milestones.description: The approved money action executes and appends a real entry to the Merkle audit chain. This is the keystone: request -> gate -> approval -> execution -> audit, with a real user and real data. The first true L4.
milestones.would_create_event: L4: first real money action end-to-end (real request->gate->approval->execution->audit, user_real=1, data_real=1)
